SIMULATED BUSINESS. This is a fictional policy for a synthetic company. It is not real.

1. Hazardous goods such as aerosols, lithium batteries and flammable liquids ship by ground service only and are not eligible for expedited delivery.
2. The delivery window for hazardous goods is 14 business days from the ship date.
3. A hazardous goods shipment is presumed lost if it is undelivered 20 business days after the ship date.
4. Perishable boxes ship with a 3 business day delivery window and are presumed lost if undelivered 5 business days after the ship date.
5. A perishable shipment that arrives spoiled must be reported within 48 hours of delivery, with a photograph.
6. Oversize items ship by freight with a 21 business day delivery window and require a delivery appointment.
7. Alcohol and other age-restricted items require an adult signature on delivery and cannot be redirected.
8. Orders to PO boxes and military addresses are limited to standard parcel items.
9. International shipping is not offered; every order must ship to a domestic address.
10. A replacement for a lost hazardous goods or oversize shipment is sent only after the carrier trace has been closed.
